title: Why stock socket.cls cannot be turned into AF_UNIX by a constant
summary: Stock ooRexx socket.cls is an IPv4/AF_INET API whose public address and bind/connect contract is not a sockaddr_un contract. Passing AF_UNIX into examples written for socket.cls crosses an API boundary that the class does not expose.
invariants: Do not present AF_UNIX boilerplate as if stock socket.cls accepted Unix-domain addresses.
Unix-domain support requires a semantic address model and a binding capable of sockaddr_un; a numeric family token alone is insufficient.
The Unix Socket library exists beside stock socket.cls and does not modify or globally override its correct INET behavior.
procedure: When an application needs AF_UNIX, require unixsocket.cls rather than attempting to coerce socket.cls.

provenance.claim: README states stock socket.cls is IPv4/AF_INET-shaped and cannot become a Unix-domain socket by passing AF_UNIX.
